name: openburnbar
description: OpenBurnBar hosted MCP for spend, sessions, knowledge, and resume. Query past agent work and usage through hosted MCP at https://mcp.burnbar.ai/mcp.

OPENBURNBAR_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: OpenBurnBar MCP access token
OPENBURNBAR_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Short-lived (~15 min) access token for the hosted OpenBurnBar MCP at https://mcp.burnbar.ai/mcp. Mint it from BurnBar Settings or with `openburnbar mcp login`, then paste the token here and configure Remote MCP in Cursor. This is a session credential, not a durable secret: re-mint it when it expires.
